items.title: `ui.yaml`: the UI's only file
items.description: `.wingfoil/ui.yaml` holds the UI's conventions (`version`, `taxonomy`, `progress`, `holds`, `artifacts`) and nothing else — no permissions (they are WingFoil's, L6), no secrets. It has a JSON schema in `contracts/`. Without it, or when it fails the schema, the UI uses inferred defaults and warns. A preset (Kanban, Scrum, `sw-life-cycle`) is offered only when the file does not exist, refused when it maps a type the project does not declare, and validated before writing. `progress.scope` declares a type only; the current element is derived.
items.fit_criterion: [boolean] Each shipped preset validates against the schema and matches its fixture; the schema rejects a `permissions` key; every scenario listed passes.

items.title: Progress scope and computations
items.description: Completion and iterated figures cover the current element of the `progress.scope` type: in v0.3, on every WingFoil version, the most advanced element not in its first or last non-archived state (ties: lowest version); none → whole project; from v0.4, on WingFoil 0.3 or later, the one `workflow status` reports. The phase figures are read-only until v0.4 (spec-005 §4). Reference completion = done linked elements / linked elements; project completion = unweighted mean over references with ≥ 1 linked element (Q8); coverage = elements carrying all `requires` categories / elements whose type has `requires`, project-wide. Open bugs and pending gates are project-wide; a state both gate and `waiting:` is not a pending gate, nor a gate whose *Approve* `ui.yaml` holds (spec-005 §4a).
items.fit_criterion: [boolean] On the custom fixture with the `sw-life-cycle` preset the UI shows exactly: scope `minor-v0.1`, project completion 25 %, tasks 1/4, open bugs 1, pending gates 3, coverage 3/5 — and, on the custom fixture with the pre-packs states and the preset (where `triaged` is both a gate and `waiting:`), pending gates 2 after `bug-001-toast-overlap` is approved to `triaged`.
